about: Researcher ruling 9.5 (2026-10-12): "re-build threads from closed escalations only if the have open items to be resolved." Scope read: closed study escalations from #1880 on (the narrative and strand period) whose text says an item was held, deferred, carried forward or left open, and which no OT row or open escalation already carries. 22 were read. Earlier closed escalations (#6 to #1823) are IBA app build items, not study threads, and were not rebuilt. Round 2 (researcher, verbatim): "approve all three only if there are open threads registered for the incomplete items in these escalations". Applied: each candidate's items were checked; a thread is rebuilt only where an item is still incomplete and no open thread carries it, and it registers one open item per incomplete point.
